source.title: Call for Applicants - WMT Members (May 2021)
source.content:
The WCA Marketing Team is seeking new members! 

**What does the WCA Marketing Team Do?**

The WMT is responsible for managing WCA relationships with external partners as well as working closely on the WCA Brand, including WCA merchandise, social media engagement and market research.

According to Motion [10.2021.7.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.7%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf), The WCA Marketing Team is responsible for developing and managing the WCA Brand, seeking sponsorships, supporting the distribution of WCA Competition Gear, and marketing WCA Merchandise. 
<!-- break -->
We are seeking members for three specific fields:

* WCA Gear Team **(US Residents only)**
 * The WCA Gear Team is responsible for managing the distribution of WCA Tournament equipment, available from Speedstacks. Your primary responsibility would be to place orders made by Delegates around the world to Speed Stacks, and ensure that they are delivered back to the delegates. In cases where international (non-US) delegates are placing orders, you will have to receive and forward them due to the limitation of Speed Stacks shipping within the US.
* Market Research & Merchandising:
 * The WCA and WMT are rapidly approaching the creation of a merchandising platform for WCA branded products. We are looking for members who have experience in either Designing Merchandise, or creating online Merchandise stores. This is a great opportunity for graphic designers to contribute to the WCA brand. You will work closely with other WCA Graphic Designers in the WCA Communications team to develop fresh designs.
* Sponsorships & Contracts
 * We are looking for members who have experience, or interest in exploring potential opportunities for sponsorships for the WCA (global and local scales). Candidates who have worked on getting sponsorships for competitions they have organized, or regional organizations they have been part of are strongly encouraged to apply and shape the future of the WCA.

Please note that your application can be tailored to one of these 3 fields, or you could instead express interest in one or more of the three (they are not exclusive).

The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered. 

**Requirements for Applicants**

* Interest and/or experience in Marketing the WCA Brand
* Approximate 5 - 10 Hours time commitment per week
* Creative mind, and the ability to work within a team 
* Familiarity in dealing with merchandising/sponsorships/vendor management is a plus
 
Applicants should submit a PDF application including a brief personal introduction, their involvement with the WCA or WCA regional organizations, their motivation for applying to the WMT and the specific team(s) they would like to work in within the WMT.
 
Applications should be sent to [sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org) from now until **June 26th, 2020, 23:59 UTC** to be considered.

translation.title: WCA 市场营销组成员招募（2021 年 5 月）
translation.content:
WCA 市场营销组正在招募新成员！

**WCA 市场营销组做什么？**

WMT 负责维护 WCA 与外部合作伙伴的关系，并参与 WCA 品牌相关工作，包括周边商品、社交媒体互动和市场调研。

根据动议 [10.2021.7.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.7%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf)，WCA 市场营销组负责发展和管理 WCA 品牌、寻找赞助、协助分发 WCA 比赛器材，以及推广 WCA 周边商品。

本次重点招募以下三个方向的成员：

* WCA 器材组（**仅限美国居民**）：
  * WCA 器材组负责分发通过 Speed Stacks 提供的 WCA 比赛器材。你的主要职责是将世界各地代表的订单提交给 Speed Stacks，并确保器材送到代表手中。由于 Speed Stacks 仅在美国境内发货，非美国代表下单时，需要你代为收货和转寄。
* 市场调研与周边商品：
  * WCA 和 WMT 正在加紧建设 WCA 品牌商品销售平台。我们希望招募有周边商品设计或网店搭建经验的成员。这是平面设计师为 WCA 品牌出力的好机会，你将与 WCA 通讯组中的其他平面设计师密切合作，推出新的设计。
* 赞助与合同：
  * 我们希望招募有相关经验或有兴趣为 WCA 寻找全球及地方赞助机会的成员。特别欢迎曾为自己组织的比赛或所在地区组织争取赞助的人申请，一同参与 WCA 的未来发展。

你可以针对上述某个方向申请，也可以表示愿意参与其中一个或多个方向；这三项工作并不互斥。

所有 WCA 成员均可申请，申请者不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

**申请要求**

* 对推广 WCA 品牌有兴趣及／或相关经验。
* 每周能投入约 5 至 10 小时。
* 有创意，能与团队合作。
* 熟悉周边商品、赞助或供应商管理者优先。

申请者须提交 PDF 格式的申请材料，包括简短的个人介绍、参与 WCA 或 WCA 地区组织的经历、申请加入 WMT 的原因，以及希望在 WMT 内参与的具体小组。

申请自即日起开放，请于 **2020 年 6 月 26 日 23:59 UTC** 前发送至 [sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org)。
notes: 原文标题为 2021 年 5 月，但申请截止日期写为 June 26th, 2020；译文忠实保留原日期，未自行更正。
